stories.title: U.S., Iran hold separate mediator talks as Mideast oil exports rebound
stories.summary: American and Iranian officials met separately with mediators Monday in pursuit of a ceasefire, while Middle Eastern crude exports climbed back to a wartime high.

stories.title: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
stories.summary: Hurricane Polo moved ashore on Mexico's Baja California peninsula, a popular tourist destination, bringing life-threatening winds and flooding around Cabo San Lucas.

stories.title: Education Department rescinds Title IX protections for LGBTQ students
stories.summary: The U.S. Education Department formally rescinded the Biden-era Title IX interpretation protecting students on the basis of sexual orientation and gender identity, returning to the 2020 rules.

stories.title: SpaceX's Starship reaches orbit for the first time but splashes down in Pacific
stories.summary: Starship reached orbit on its 14th test flight — a milestone for NASA's Artemis program — but an engine failure forced an early splashdown in the Pacific on its planned six-lap mission.

stories.title: AMD to acquire Fei-Fei Li's World Labs for $8.2 billion
stories.summary: AMD agreed to buy World Labs, the spatial-intelligence startup founded by AI researcher Fei-Fei Li, for $8.2 billion — a major bet by the chipmaker on AI that can understand and generate 3D space.

stories.title: Nvidia launches platform for reining in rogue AI agents
stories.summary: Nvidia introduced a new platform aimed at monitoring and controlling autonomous AI agents, responding to concerns about agents acting beyond their intended scope.

stories.title: Anthropic releases Sonnet 5.5, a cheaper, faster work companion
stories.summary: Anthropic unveiled Sonnet 5.5, positioning the model as a significantly cheaper and faster assistant for knowledge work.

stories.title: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
stories.summary: Modal Labs, an inference and compute platform for AI workloads, is nearing a $750 million funding round at a $15.75 billion valuation, per sources.

stories.title: Browns guard Joel Bitonio announces retirement after 12 seasons
stories.summary: Joel Bitonio, a 2014 second-round pick who spent his entire 12-year career in Cleveland, announced his retirement on Tuesday — a significant loss for the Browns' offensive line.

stories.title: Browns' injury report for Week 4 against the Steelers
stories.summary: Fresh off a 21-18 win over Carolina, the Browns issued their first Week 4 injury report ahead of a quick turnaround against Pittsburgh, with several starters listed as the short week begins.

stories.title: Browns place Sampson and Davis on injured reserve Tuesday
stories.summary: Cleveland placed running back Sampson (knee) and cornerback Davis (quadriceps) on injured reserve on Tuesday, thinning the roster for the Steelers matchup.

stories.title: Ohio State at Iowa: time, channel and injury updates
stories.summary: The Dispatch previews Ohio State's trip to Iowa, coming off QB Julian Sayin's statement game (27-for-36, 367 yards, 4 TDs vs. Illinois) but facing a stiffer Hawkeyes challenge.

stories.title: Ohio State roster budgets: Does spending equal winning?
stories.summary: NBC4 digs into Ohio State's roster spending versus on-field results as revenue-sharing reshapes how the Buckeyes allocate their football budget.

stories.title: Canal Winchester football coach resigns after investigation
stories.summary: A Canal Winchester football coach resigned following an investigation into alleged unprofessional conduct, leaving the program to regroup.

stories.title: Three men sentenced after fight led to Columbus man's death
stories.summary: Three men were sentenced in connection with a Columbus altercation that resulted in a man's death, closing a case that drew attention in the city.

stories.title: Pedestrian struck and killed in southeast Columbus
stories.summary: A pedestrian was struck and killed in southeast Columbus, the latest in a series of pedestrian-safety incidents around the city.

stories.title: Mac and cheese festival returning to Easton on Friday
stories.summary: The mac and cheese festival returns to Easton Town Center in Columbus on Friday, raising money for cancer research at the family-friendly food event.
